g.text: Pi-Gen imaging: lifecycle of one cluster node, from image to verified member
Re-personalizing a booted node does nothing:
firstboot.done blocks a second run. Reflash
or delete the marker to change identity.
FINDING (likely): the unit puts StartLimitIntervalSec= in [Service].
systemd only accepts that key in [Unit] (the [Service] spelling is
StartLimitInterval=), so it is ignored, the 10 s default applies, and
with RestartSec=120 the burst of 5 is never reached: the service
retries every 2 min indefinitely. Check: systemd-analyze verify.
start limit hit (if it ever applies)
